hero_sub: Rubu Al Quds for Trading & Food Industries — bringing the world's finest brands to the Levant since 1966.
about: Established in 1966 in the heart of Amman's Al-Abdali district, Rubu Al Quds has grown from a family-owned enterprise into one of the region's most trusted food import, distribution and brand-management houses. Across three generations we have built an end-to-end supply chain — from global sourcing and international trade to HORECA and retail delivery — representing the world's most renowned food and beverage brands under our own flagship 7 Boys® label and through exclusive regional partnerships.
why: Wide range of premium products | Competitive direct-import pricing | Fresh stock & fast delivery | Customizable private labeling | Certification & logistics assistance | delivery across the Levant

timeline.p: Founded in Al-Abdali, Amman as a family-owned food trading house.
Became a leading FMCG distributor across the Levant.
Direct import partnerships with +200 renowned European & global brands.
Proprietary gourmet line: cheeses, olives, capers, anchovies & more.
